title: The Bots Must Be Crazy
note: The main motif climbs 0-2-4-5 and falls back through 4-2-1 to the root, returning throughout as a music box over soft plucked bass, tender and childlike like a lullaby.

title: The Bots Must Be Crazy
note: The main motif is root–supertonic–mediant, rising to the sixth and falling back through the second to the root; it opens story, recurs lightly in calm, darkens in hard, and resolves in end. The score is a warm, gentle chiptune of square lead, triangle-like bass and bells over parchment, gold and ink.

title: The Bots Must Be Crazy
note: The main motif is 0-2-4-3-2-0, a small stepwise rise and fall that returns on flute, bells and pluck in folk-dorian and major dress; the score uses a flute lead over plucked strings and a soft pad, warm as a painted village map.
